entries.decision: Decorate only an actual PCS V2.1 XSD INVALID result caused by ErrorCode=OperationNotSupported on the exact PCS V2.1 -> Common V1.0 -> Enumerations V1.0 route.
guards: official PassengerCountingService V2.1 exact dependency route only
match only ErrorCode value OperationNotSupported in a selected Common V1.0 ErrorCodeEnumeration position
must not substitute, merge, or auto-upgrade to Enumerations V2.1
must not inject OperationNotSupported into the selected V1.0 enum pool
must preserve existing V1.0 values such as DataNotValid as normal valid values
